# Cartoon AI characters in 1990s sitcom, 3D film and anime looks

**An original character, or your own photo, redrawn in a famous animation look from a written style block, never a show name.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1602c5ec7ca3.webp" alt="A model sheet of an original felt-puppet lighthouse keeper with teal felt skin, a fluffy white beard, a monocle and a lantern, then a push-in on his grinning and worried expressions." width="480"></p>

Makes original cartoon characters in famous, instantly recognisable looks on varg: the yellow 1990s family sitcom, the 3D family feature film, hand-painted anime, paper cut-out, adult sci-fi cartoon, felt puppet and others, described in words instead of IP names (the names get blocked and do not belong in ads). Also restyles an existing character into those looks. Use when someone asks for a Simpsons-style, Pixar-style, Ghibli-style, South Park-style or Rick and Morty-style character, a cartoon version of a person or mascot, or "me as a cartoon". Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-cartoon                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-cartoon --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Cartoon model sheet in the chosen look |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Uses | varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3 |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Turn ./me.jpg into a cartoon character in a yellow 1990s family-sitcom look, without naming the show"
- "Make an original 3D family-film style mascot for my bakery and a model sheet"
- "Redraw my mascot ./mascot.png as a felt puppet and in a hand-painted pastoral anime look"
